reason: The quickstart's Data Preparation section gives a CPU-only tools/preprocess_data.py CLI with an openly downloadable tokenizer, while the GPU training examples are skipped.
goal: Install Megatron-LM enough that `python tools/preprocess_data.py --input data.jsonl --output-prefix out --tokenizer-type HuggingFaceTokenizer --tokenizer-model <dir> --workers 2 --append-eod` runs on CPU, where <dir> is a local copy of the GPT-2 tokenizer from Hugging Face (openai-community/gpt2, not gated: config.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, vocab.json, merges.txt). The input is a JSONL file with a `text` field per line. It must produce out_text_document.bin and out_text_document.idx, which load with megatron.core.datasets.indexed_dataset.IndexedDataset.
check: Runs the preprocessing CLI on a generated 20-document JSONL with a downloaded GPT-2 tokenizer directory and verifies the output loads as an indexed dataset with 20 documents that decode back to the original text and end with the EOD token.

revision.by: fairness review (every maintained-set exam re-checked against the source)
issues: Oracle (and goal) hand Megatron a 4-file GPT-2 tokenizer dir without config.json. openai-community/gpt2's tokenizer_config.json is only {model_max_length}, so HF AutoTokenizer cannot resolve GPT2Tokenizer: transformers 4.x raises 'Unrecognized model' (unless the path contains 'gpt2'), 5.x falls back to a generic backend with eos_token=None

This is an incomplete input the oracle built, not a Megatron defect: Megatron's HuggingFaceTokenizer only calls AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path), which works on a normal HF download (with config.json)
Goal text pins the same incomplete 4-file list, so the goal must change too
evidence: src/nvidia-megatron-lm@19895da megatron/core/tokenizers/text/libraries/huggingface_tokenizer.py:109-122 - plain AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained; :402-405 eod is None when eos_token is None

transformers 5.19.0 (pinned by Megatron's uv.lock per NOTES.md) models/auto/tokenization_auto.py:805-811 - AutoConfig failure falls back to PreTrainedConfig (no model_type) -> generic TokenizersBackend; models/gpt2/tokenization_gpt2.py:101 - GPT2Tokenizer defaults eos_token='<|endoftext|>', reached only when config.json gives model_type gpt2
data/runs/nvidia-megatron-lm/result.json audit evidence_out - the same 4 files load when the dir is named gpt2 and fail under /tmp/a1/tok: name-dependent behaviour of an incomplete input
docs/get-started/quickstart.md 'Preprocess the Data' - only says --tokenizer-model is a path to the tokenizer; nothing about a stripped file set
